problem: Folder preparation used global RAW settings and fitted-view detail. Saved per-photo engines/WB and native zoom could trigger RAW development after completion.
changes: Load the photo recipe before preparation; ignore temporary Before view. Prepare native detail in Full and the existing capped detail in Standard, using the effective per-photo quality.
Complete each photo only against its current request and after accepted asynchronous cache writes finish.

Retain independently readable viewer mip tails ahead of optional native ancestors. If native detail exceeds disk/queue bounds, preserve the existing computed viewing preview with accounted copy credits and report the limit.
Reuse stored previews selecting the same canonical mip even when nominal edges differ; preserve source, engine, WB and quality separation.
Keep refinement status truthful. Source hashing/cache reads, GPU upload and viewport rendering are still performed when needed.

verification.regressions: All engines/qualities, saved engine/WB before preparation, cache quota retaining all fitted previews, equivalent mip lookup, queue-over-limit fallback, cancellation and source/recipe isolation.

raw_matrix.saved_recipe_on_second_photo: Different RAW engine and native white balance from global preferences.

native_navigation.scope: Full CPU/GPU and Standard GPU for all four engines. Fit, 300%, pan, quality changes and physical 1:1. Changes to a quality not prepared may develop new pixels and are excluded from the zero-decode claim.

limitations: Cache disabled, quotas, I/O errors, source/recipe/quality changes or external eviction can require additional work. Native data for an arbitrarily large folder cannot be guaranteed inside a fixed quota.
Two D750 sources, macOS Apple M4/Metal. No new other-camera, Windows, physical-memory or colour qualification; no SF/R0-R4 gate closure.
Readback and CPU-delivery timings are descriptive functional samples; no controlled before/after speedup, physical monitor timing or p95/p99 claim. GPU capability fallbacks to CPU are recorded.
Preliminary campaigns remain under raw-matrix/ and native/. Only final delivery campaigns above are counted.
